study.question: Does moving the committed g2 reliability shrinkage into the separate feedback-rate inputs of the stronger g0/content-only residual improve validation macro AUC beyond the raw-rate incumbent, and does ad-diversity support add value over exposure support and user-background rates?
study.hypothesis: Observed: g2-r0019-content_rates macro AUC 0.8315142702328122 exceeds g0-r0013-pair_joint_both 0.8314095190610717 by only 0.00010475117174046922, with worse macro Logloss by 0.000007826838391421231 and favorite AUC lower by 0.00001732018301237037. Its rate-versus-count contrast is +0.00011556254814149014. Source inspection shows content replacement discards the shrunk centered-product moments, leaving raw feedback fractions; support_mode therefore has no active effect on these rate inputs. Sparse local rates may still benefit from reliability shrinkage without multiplying the content representation. The inherited visible-user background includes the slot and is not an independent prior. Diversity is an unverified proxy for dependence, not a statistical effective sample size guarantee. All observations are single-seed and mechanism support is provisional. Relative to g0, content_rates per-task AUC deltas in is_click/cart/fav/buy order are [+0.000040309290558981914,+0.00019320219768514946,-0.00001732018301237037,+0.00020281338173011587], with Logloss deltas [+0.000048493038223601515,+0.000007192879790014761,+0.0000010672407026197234,-0.00002544580515054934]. Earlier joint_diversity minus joint_exposure was -0.0000010460437224 macro AUC; marginal_diversity/exposure were worse at0.8308674678240657/0.8308587736085302. Product_counts0.8312738849135548 and content_counts0.8313987076846707 are retained negative controls; none is erased or called an independent mechanism repetition.

inherited_components: Complete committed g0-r0013-pair_joint_both backbone: embeddings, local activation, recency/relation summaries, linear position moments, relation/content banks, feedback memory, joint pair summaries, interaction and towers.
g2-r0016-diversity_factorized eight old/recent x category/brand bins, histogram diversity, strength4 shrinkage toward the same visible-user rates.
g2-r0019-content_rates content-only 8D projection, duplicated content block, raw exposure count block, 64-hidden residual, zero final output and RNG isolation.
study.proposed_difference: Add a rate_summary selector with raw compatibility, smoothed, and background modes. Smoothed uses the existing g2 support/(support+4) interpolation on the separate feedback-rate block, leaving projected content unchanged. Background repeats the visible-user four rates. All modes explicitly zero empty slots; all new variants compute the same summaries before selection. No added parameters, tokens, losses, inputs or changes to the host recipe. Three standalone modules form an exposure/diversity reliability contrast plus a background-only replacement control; the committed raw-rate model is the fourth control.
predictions: Exposure-smoothed separate rates outperform raw g2-r0019-content_rates if extreme low-support fractions are a consequential limitation, especially in predeclared low-count/repetition strata. If the authorized host diagnostics expose these quantities, use fixed slot-count bins 0,1,2-4,5-16,17-100 and occupied-slot diversity/exposure ratios (0,0.5],(0.5,1); report sample and per-task positive/negative counts and mark insufficient slices. These are secondary diagnostics, not selection criteria; no unavailable sample/user metadata is assumed.

If diversity captures consequential redundancy, diversity_rates beats exposure_rates on validation macro AUC with changes concentrated in repeated-ad slots; unique-ad support should agree algebraically.
Local shrinkage beats background_rates if local feedback is useful beyond visible-user composition and slot occupancy. No required superiority of diversity is assumed.

All arms start with the same backbone outputs because the residual final layer is zero; all-empty histories receive exactly zero added logits; masked IDs/task-mask entries and target action cannot affect outputs.
falsifiers: No candidate exceeds raw incumbent 0.8315142702328122 under the fixed macro-AUC rule: no added predictive benefit established; compare both source bests separately.
Diversity fails to beat exposure, or apparent gains disappear on paired validation repetition: no support for diversity-specific transfer.
Background-only rates match local shrinkage: no evidence for local feedback reliability beyond scale/background/occupancy.
Host equivalence, masking, finite forward/backward, BF16 or parameter checks fail: execution/integrity failure, not scientific counterevidence; preserve charged receipt.
A macro gain with worse individual tasks or Logloss must be reported as a trade-off; no undeclared veto or significance claim.
alternative_explanations: Seed/optimization noise and validation winner selection explain the tiny observed and future gains.
A changed feature scale or effective input rank eases the residual MLP optimization without improving rate estimation.
Repeated advertisement IDs need not imply correlated feedback; diversity may shrink useful repetition.
The backbone already encodes relevant feedback and the extra readout is redundant; added capacity explains source-vs-g0 differences.
The background includes each local group, so this is deterministic smoothing under offline visibility, not independent-prior inference.
Official offline action visibility, static snapshots, vocabularies, category/brand auxiliary labels and encoded-ID collisions limit production interpretation.
